subject: Director of Finance Appointment
overview: The School Committee met in a special session to consider district leadership and voted to approve Noel L. Velez as the Director of Finance for Medford Public Schools.

items.title: Appointment of Director of Finance Noel L. Velez
items.summary: Approved the appointment of Noel L. Velez as the Director of Finance for Medford Public Schools following an introduction by Superintendent Marice Edouard-Vincent and discussion of his background in Winthrop and Chelsea.
